scope.purpose: Freeze the finite vocabulary, constants, dependency contracts, comparator, denominators, and fail-closed proof policy used to decide Knowledge Sufficiency before any implementation or proof run.

preservedProcessContext.integrationRule: This record specializes only the bounded CKS-07 decision vocabulary and proof policy. It creates no alternate workflow, authority path, promotion path, or evidence exception.

canonicalJson.use: Canonical UTF-8 bytes before SHA-256 for every interface digest defined by this record.

normativeRepositoryBindings.bindingRule: A future CKS-07 implementation must consume these contracts without weakening their validation, applicability, generation, promotion, or authority boundaries.

finiteVocabulary.closedWorldRule: Any unlisted value is invalid. A required input containing an unlisted value produces caseOutcome BLOCKED with blockedReason UNKNOWN_VOCABULARY_VALUE; it is never coerced to the nearest known value.

identity.requirementKeyDerivation: lowercase-hex SHA-256 of canonicalJson({caseId,requirementSetDigest,requirementId}) encoded as UTF-8
identity.statementBinding: Each oracle requirement binds its exact statement with statementDigest; text resemblance, embedding similarity, popularity, or a model assertion is not identity.
identity.candidateIdentity: candidateId is unique only within candidateSetDigest and is never an oracle requirement identity.
identity.matching: Only a digest-bound semantic-adjudication receipt using the declared semanticRuleSetDigest may map one candidateId to one requirementId.
identity.oneToOneCounting: For an oracle requirement with multiple MATCH candidates, the lexicographically first candidateId is the one true-positive match and every additional mapped candidate is a false positive. A candidate may map to at most one oracle requirement.
identity.unknownSemanticRule: If a present deterministic rule returns UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC, the requirement fails closed as GAP_UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC. If the required rule or its evidence is absent, the case is BLOCKED rather than classified or scored.

criticality.oracleRule: Every APPLICABLE oracle requirement has exactly one criticality: CRITICAL or NON_CRITICAL. UNKNOWN is forbidden in the oracle.
criticality.candidateRule: A candidate may declare UNKNOWN, but UNKNOWN never satisfies criticality and cannot be silently mapped to NON_CRITICAL.
criticality.criticalMissDefinition: An APPLICABLE CRITICAL oracle requirement is a critical requirement miss when it has no one-to-one MATCH or when its counted MATCH candidate is not labelled CRITICAL.
criticality.criticalityMismatchDefinition: Any counted MATCH whose candidate criticality differs from oracle criticality is a criticality mismatch.
criticality.notApplicableRule: NOT_APPLICABLE excludes a requirement only when the oracle binds a present applicabilityRuleId and its evidence. Absence, retrieval failure, or source mismatch can never infer NOT_APPLICABLE.
criticality.unknownApplicabilityRule: UNKNOWN oracle applicability or an absent required applicability rule makes the case BLOCKED; UNKNOWN candidate applicability makes the requirement GAP_APPLICABILITY.

precedenceHighestFirst.condition: At least one otherwise admissible candidate needed to decide the requirement has a present semantic rule whose result is UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC.
Two or more semantically known, source-admissible, applicable accepted Knowledge items make unresolved incompatible claims.
A semantically known, source-admissible candidate exists, but a material context value is UNKNOWN or NOT_PROVIDED, or exact applicability to the case is not proven.
No satisfying ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE item exists and the only claimed matches are evidence, Internet, model, unknown-source, invalid, stale, unbound, or non-curated items.
A0, A1, and A2 each produced a valid digest-bound NO_MATCH receipt and no higher-precedence gap applies.
Exactly one or more mutually compatible ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE items satisfy the known semantic and applicability rules with complete bindings.

gapPolicy.foldRule: Evaluate source eligibility before using a candidate, then apply the highest listed applicable gap across all eligible candidates. Excluded-source content may establish only BAD_SOURCE, never UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC, CONFLICTING, APPLICABILITY, NONE, or SATISFIED.
gapPolicy.terminalNotApplicable: A requirement proven NOT_APPLICABLE by its bound oracle rule has requirementOutcome NOT_APPLICABLE and does not enter gap precedence or metric denominators.
gapPolicy.failClosedRule: Every gap outcome is INSUFFICIENT. No rank is a confidence score, no lower rank overrides a higher rank, and ranking never selects between conflicting claims.

satisfyingClassConditions: The KnowledgeEnvelopeV1 validates against the exact bound KnowledgeTaxonomyV1.
The envelopeDigest is present in the exact active immutable KnowledgeEditionV1.
The KnowledgeLkgPointerV1 validates and binds that exact edition digest and generation.
A KnowledgeSelectionV1 with mode CURATED selects the exact envelope digest for the exact namespace, taxonomy, generation, and evaluated policy.
The envelope remains fresh, permitted, non-conflicting, semantically known, and applicable for the requirement.
boundaryRules: Pinned provenance supports reviewability but does not itself create accepted Knowledge.
An Internet result remains INTERNET_RESULT even when its bytes, locator, and digest are pinned.
A model result remains MODEL_RESULT even when structured, deterministic at a pinned seed, or consistent with another result.
A qualification receipt with outcome PROPOSED remains a proposal and activation NOT_AUTHORIZED.
Only a separate governed promotion that produces and validates a new immutable edition and exact LKG binding can make a future item eligible for ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE.
Knowledge of every source class retains the existing read-only authority boundary and grants no Authority.

levelSemantics.name: CURRENT_KNOWLEDGE_PRIMARY_RETRIEVAL
levelSemantics.meaning: Run the declared primary deterministic retrieval once against the exact current ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE bundle. No new content is acquired.

levelSemantics.name: DETERMINISTIC_QUERY_RECOVERY
levelSemantics.meaning: After A0 NO_MATCH, run one rule-identified deterministic alternate query against the same immutable Knowledge bundle and primary retriever.

levelSemantics.name: ALTERNATE_RETRIEVER_RECOVERY
levelSemantics.meaning: After A1 NO_MATCH, run one declared deterministic alternate retriever or index strategy against the same immutable Knowledge bundle; retrieverId must differ from A0 and A1 strategy identity.

levelSemantics.name: PINNED_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_CANDIDATE
levelSemantics.meaning: Represent owner-supplied or approved pinned local evidence as a contribution candidate with provenance, licence, applicability, and digest bindings.

levelSemantics.name: PINNED_INTERNET_EVIDENCE_CANDIDATE
levelSemantics.meaning: If separately authorized outside this slice, acquire and pin external bytes, locator, provenance, licence, and retrieval evidence as INTERNET_RESULT only.

levelSemantics.name: MODEL_ASSISTED_CANDIDATE
levelSemantics.meaning: If separately authorized outside this slice, a model may propose a query, extraction, relation, or synthesized candidate bound to its inputs; the output remains MODEL_RESULT and PROPOSAL only.

acquisitionPolicy.orderingRule: A0, A1, and A2 are ordered retrieval recovery over already accepted Knowledge. A3, A4, and A5 are acquisition candidate classes after a gap and are not retrieval recovery, qualification success, promotion, selection, or Authority.
acquisitionPolicy.promotionSeparationRule: No A0-A5 receipt is a promotion receipt. A3-A5 output cannot change the current edition or LKG pointer and cannot close a gap until a separate, later, governed promotion is proven and the next sufficiency run consumes that newly accepted immutable state.

retrievalRecoveryBudget.recoveryDefinition: A requirement is recovered only when A0 has a valid NO_MATCH receipt and A1 or A2 returns a QUALIFYING_MATCH from ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE under all semantic, source, conflict, and applicability gates.
retrievalRecoveryBudget.missingDeclarationRule: GAP_MISSING is legal only after exactly three ordered receipts for A0, A1, and A2 all say NO_MATCH over one identical knowledgeBundleDigest. Fewer attempts, a repeated strategy masquerading as A2, a bundle change, or an unavailable receipt produces BLOCKED, not MISSING.
retrievalRecoveryBudget.nonNoMatchRule: BAD_SOURCE, APPLICABILITY, CONFLICTING, and UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC are terminal fail-closed classifications for this run. Additional retrieval cannot silently wash out or downgrade those states.
retrievalRecoveryBudget.budgetExhaustionRule: Exhaustion authorizes only a GAP_MISSING decision and an optional A3-A5 recommendation. It authorizes no network call, model call, acquisition, qualification, promotion, activation, or Authority.

sufficiencyPolicy.blockedPriority: If any required dependency, digest, semantic rule, applicability rule, source rule, attempt receipt, or proof denominator is absent or invalid, outcome is BLOCKED before evaluating SUFFICIENT or INSUFFICIENT.
conjunction: All required dependency interfaces validate and their digests bind one immutable case input.
P11 requirement recall is 1/1 and precision is 1/1 under one-to-one oracle matching.
P11 critical requirement misses equal zero and criticality mismatches equal zero.
Every APPLICABLE oracle requirement has requirementOutcome SATISFIED and gapClass NONE.
Every satisfying item has sourceClass ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE and passes semantic, conflict, freshness, and applicability rules.
Every NO_MATCH-to-MISSING path has complete ordered A0-A2 recovery receipts within budget.
No acquisition or qualification candidate is counted as promoted, selected, accepted Knowledge, or Authority.
sufficiencyPolicy.formula: SUFFICIENT iff dependency_gate AND recall_gate AND precision_gate AND critical_miss_gate AND criticality_gate AND per_requirement_knowledge_gate AND recovery_gate AND promotion_separation_gate; BLOCKED has priority; every other evaluated outcome is INSUFFICIENT.
sufficiencyPolicy.noPartialCreditRule: Scores and confidence may be reported as diagnostics but cannot replace the conjunction, offset one failed gate, or turn INSUFFICIENT or BLOCKED into SUFFICIENT.

P11.name: REQUIREMENT_IDENTITY_AND_CRITICALITY

symbols.P: Count of schema-valid candidate requirements, including duplicate semantic predictions as separate predictions.
symbols.M: Count of one-to-one MATCH predictions after duplicate handling.
symbols.C: Count of APPLICABLE CRITICAL oracle requirements.
symbols.CX: Count of criticality mismatches among counted MATCH predictions.

metrics.requirementPrecision: M / P when P > 0; 0 when P = 0 and R > 0

P11.passRule: M = R, M = P, CM = 0, and CX = 0.
P11.blockedRule: Absent oracle, absent semantic adjudication, R = 0, or C = 0 makes P11 BLOCKED; no value is imputed.

P12.name: ALTERNATE_RETRIEVAL_RECOVERY_AND_PROMOTION_SEPARATION

symbols.E1: Count of requirements whose A0 outcome is NO_MATCH and whose bound fixture has its earliest qualifying accepted hit at A1.
symbols.E2: Count of requirements whose A0 and A1 outcomes are NO_MATCH and whose bound fixture has its earliest qualifying accepted hit at A2.
symbols.REC: Count of E1 plus E2 requirements recovered at the expected earliest alternate level.
symbols.VM: Count of GAP_MISSING declarations backed by all three valid NO_MATCH receipts and a bound truly-missing oracle result.
symbols.ACQ: Count of A3-A5 acquisition candidate receipts in the proof suite.
symbols.PL: Count of A3-A5 candidates represented as promoted, selected ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE, or Authority without separate governed promotion evidence.

P12.passRule: REC = E1 + E2, VM = MD, PL = 0, and every attempt and acquisition receipt validates.
P12.blockedRule: A zero required denominator, missing attempt, missing acquisition evidence, absent oracle result, or changed knowledgeBundleDigest makes P12 BLOCKED; it is not a failed recovery or synthetic success.

P13.name: FALSE_COMPLETENESS_REDUCTION

symbols.CFC: Count of cases where the combined process says SUFFICIENT while the oracle says INSUFFICIENT.
symbols.SFC: Count of cases where the frozen simple solver says COMPLETE while the oracle says INSUFFICIENT.
symbols.CTC: Count of oracle SUFFICIENT cases where the combined process says SUFFICIENT.

P13.passRule: CFC = 0, SFC > CFC, and CTC = OS using the same cases and denominator bytes for both solvers.
P13.blockedRule: Absent comparator input, absent oracle outcome, OI = 0, OS = 0, any required BLOCKED case, or denominator drift makes P13 BLOCKED; blocked cases cannot be dropped to improve either rate.

simpleSolverComparator.inputParityRule: The simple solver and combined process consume the identical requirement-candidate set, A0 candidate bytes, case context, and fixture digest. The oracle remains evaluator-only.
algorithm: If the candidate requirement set or any required A0 receipt is absent or invalid, return BLOCKED.
If the candidate requirement set is empty, return INCOMPLETE.
For each candidate requirement, inspect only its A0 receipt.
Mark that candidate covered when A0 returned at least one candidate envelope digest, regardless of source class, semantic status, conflict, applicability, freshness, curation, or promotion status.
Return COMPLETE when every candidate requirement is covered; otherwise return INCOMPLETE.
simpleSolverComparator.freezeRule: The comparator algorithm and id are immutable for one proof suite. Tuning it after observing combined-process results invalidates P13.

dependencyInterfaces.nullabilityRule: requirementId is non-null only for MATCH; ruleId is always non-null. A missing required rule blocks the case rather than emitting a guessed mapping.

proofIntegration.overallRule: The future proof receipt is PASS only when P11, P12, and P13 are each PASS. FAIL, BLOCKED, and NOT_RUN never aggregate to PASS.

P11Cases: exact identity and criticality positive case
required semantic rule absent produces BLOCKED
P12Cases: A1 alternate-query recovery after A0 NO_MATCH
A2 alternate-retriever recovery after A0 and A1 NO_MATCH
true MISSING only after three NO_MATCH receipts
P13Cases: at least one oracle SUFFICIENT case accepted by the conjunction
requiredProofCoverage.coverageRule: Every named case requires real digest-bound fixture and run evidence. A narrative, fabricated metric, duplicated case under a new name, or synthetic substitute for an absent dependency does not satisfy coverage.

triggers: A required dependency interface is absent.
A dependency schema or digest does not validate.
A required semantic, applicability, or source-classification rule is absent.
A required retrieval or acquisition receipt is absent.
A required metric denominator lacks evidence.
Comparator or oracle bytes are absent or differ between compared runs.
noDataPolicy.metricTreatment: Do not emit zero, one, PASS, MISSING, or an estimated metric for the affected proof. Emit BLOCKED with the exact finite blocked reason and retain the absent field as absent.
noDataPolicy.antiFabricationRule: No model output, Internet result, inferred label, copied historical score, generated placeholder, or synthetic result may fill missing dependency evidence or a missing semantic rule.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Use normalized text, embeddings, or model confidence as requirement identity.
alternativesConsidered.reason: It makes identity and P11 matching non-deterministic and can hide UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Use weighted criticality scores or silently treat UNKNOWN as non-critical.
alternativesConsidered.reason: A binary oracle plus explicit candidate UNKNOWN makes critical misses finite and fail closed.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Declare MISSING after the primary retrieval returns no hit.
alternativesConsidered.reason: It cannot prove P12 alternate retrieval recovery and confuses retrieval failure with Knowledge absence.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Allow unbounded query retries or stop when a confidence threshold is reached.
alternativesConsidered.reason: It is not a finite deterministic recovery policy and permits result-shopping.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Count pinned owner, primary, Internet, or model material as accepted Knowledge on arrival.
alternativesConsidered.reason: Acquisition, qualification, promotion, curated selection, and Authority are separate transitions.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Make A5 a promotion or acceptance level.
alternativesConsidered.reason: A model proposal is untrusted data and no acquisition level grants promotion.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Use a weighted score or OR across requirement and Knowledge gates.
alternativesConsidered.reason: A high score could offset a critical miss, conflict, bad source, or applicability gap and create false completeness.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Treat a zero or absent denominator as perfect performance or omit blocked cases.
alternativesConsidered.reason: It fabricates proof through no-data and denominator selection.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Compare against a moving or post-hoc tuned baseline.
alternativesConsidered.reason: P13 requires one frozen simple solver on identical input bytes and denominators.
Micro counts expose the exact requirement and case denominators and avoid undefined per-case ratio conventions.

implementationOrProofMustFail: Any Internet or model result is represented as ACTIVE_CURATED_KNOWLEDGE without separate governed promotion evidence.
Any Knowledge item or acquisition result grants credential, policy, approval, capability, tool, write, execution, or other Authority.
GAP_MISSING is emitted without exact ordered A0, A1, and A2 NO_MATCH receipts over one knowledgeBundleDigest.
An A3-A5 candidate changes an edition, LKG pointer, accepted Knowledge set, or sufficiency result in the same run.
A conflict, semantic unknown, bad source, or unproven applicability is classified SATISFIED.
P11, P12, or P13 claims PASS while a required observed negative case fails.
P13 uses different cases, input bytes, oracle bytes, or denominator bytes for the two solvers.
The simple solver is changed after results are observed.
A proof receipt reports PASS from narrative or invented values rather than real dependency and run evidence.
implementationOrProofMustBlock: A required dependency or semantic rule is absent.
A required digest or schema is invalid.
A required denominator is zero because its fixture evidence is absent.
A required attempt receipt or comparator input is absent.
An unknown vocabulary value is encountered.
decisionSliceMustReject: Any model, network, provider, Docker, or external service invocation for product evidence.
Any GitHub mutation, release, merge, push, or issue closure.
Any write outside the single allowlisted decision artifact.

explicitNonclaims: This record does not implement CKS-07 or any product code.
This record does not prove P11, P12, or P13; their proof status is NOT_RUN.
This record contains no requirement-discovery, retrieval, acquisition, qualification, promotion, model, Internet, or service result.
This record does not establish corpus completeness, semantic correctness, source truth, production fitness, performance, availability, or generalization.
This record does not accept, curate, promote, activate, publish, supersede, or revoke Knowledge.
This record grants no credential, Policy, Approval, capability, tool, network, write, execution, release, or other Authority.
A future PASS on local fixtures would remain bounded to the exact policy, suite, bytes, versions, environment, and evidence window in that proof receipt.
No Internet or model result is automatically accepted Knowledge or Authority.

verification.verificationBoundary: Syntax and repository diff hygiene validate this decision artifact only; they do not change P11, P12, or P13 from NOT_RUN.
